user.title: Ecodan Dashboard
user.description: Adds a panel to the sidebar with a live installation diagram of the Ecodan heat pump. The MELCloud entities are detected automatically; the entity prefix and manual mapping can be set later via Configure.

init.title: Ecodan Dashboard
init.description: Changes apply immediately; reload the panel in your browser or app afterwards.

data.prefix: Entity prefix of the Ecodan device
data.stooklijn_buiten_koud: Heating curve: outdoor temperature of the cold point
data.stooklijn_aanvoer_koud: Heating curve: flow temperature at the cold point
data.stooklijn_buiten_warm: Heating curve: outdoor temperature of the warm point
data.stooklijn_aanvoer_warm: Heating curve: flow temperature at the warm point
data.stooklijn_middenpunt: Heating curve: use an adjustment point
data.stooklijn_midden_buiten: Heating curve: outdoor temperature of the adjustment point
data.stooklijn_midden_aanvoer: Heating curve: flow temperature at the adjustment point

data_description.prefix: The part between the domain and the sensor name, e.g. technische_ruimte_ecodan for sensor.technische_ruimte_ecodan_tanktemperatuur.
data_description.klep_aan_is_tapwater: Turn this off if the diagram shows heating while the tank is being heated.
data_description.overrides: E.g. water_heater: water_heater.ecodan. Leave empty for automatic detection. See the README for all keys.
data_description.thema: Default for everyone. The sun/moon button in the panel overrides it per device.
data_description.stooklijn_buiten_koud: Copy these from the Ecodan display (Heating → Compensation curve). The panel cannot read them from MELCloud. At this outdoor temperature and colder, the flow temperature is the value below.
data_description.stooklijn_buiten_warm: At this outdoor temperature and warmer, the flow temperature is the value below. Must be warmer than the cold point.
data_description.stooklijn_middenpunt: Only if an adjustment point is set on the display; it must lie between the cold and the warm point.
data_description.stooklijn_verschuiving: Shift of the whole curve, as set on the display (−5 to +5 °C). Usually 0.

error.curve_order: The warm point must be warmer than the cold point
error.curve_flow: The flow temperature at the warm point cannot be higher than at the cold point
error.curve_mid: The adjustment point must lie between the cold and the warm point
